settingsForm.languageHelp: This will change the language of the cards and app, but will default to English if a card or text is not available in the selected language.
settingsForm.phaseTransitionNotificationsHelp: Show a full-screen notification when the game enters a new phase.
settingsForm.spectatorsHelp: When on, new games you start are listed on the home page for anyone to watch. You still choose per game when you start one, and that choice is fixed for the life of that game.
settingsForm.betaWarning: Beta features are likely very broken and games may be unrecoverable, please only enable this if you are willing to provide feedback.
settingsForm.epicMultiplayerWarning: Epic Multiplayer is under active development — it does not work yet. Enable only for testing.
settingsForm.dangerZoneDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data, including games and decks.
settingsForm.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? All your games, decks, and account data will be permanently lost and cannot be recovered.
settingsForm.betaHelp: Try upcoming features before they are released to everyone.
settingsForm.experimentsWarning: Experimental features may change, stop working, or be removed at any time. They can break games in progress or leave them unrecoverable. Enable them only if you are comfortable with these risks and willing to provide feedback.
settingsForm.usedRevisedCoreArt: Use revised core art in Encounter sets
settingsForm.revisedCoreArtDescription: Shows the Revised Core Set artwork for supported encounter cards, including enemies, treacheries, locations, and agendas. Only artwork changes—not card rules or player cards. This preference applies only to your view; other players keep their own art settings.
settingsForm.customCardsWarning: Experimental. This feature can stop working, break a game in progress, or be removed at any time. Custom cards are only ever as correct as the definition behind them, and the builder can express things the engine will happily run but no printed card would ever do.
settingsForm.customCardsHelp: Adds a Card Builder to the menu, where you can make your own cards and add them to a game from the debug menu. It also lets you lay an overlay over a deck, from the {icon} button on a deck or beside a deck when you pick one for a game: swap in a custom investigator (their signatures come with them, and the old ones go), and add or remove cards. An overlay applied on the deck page sticks to that deck until you remove it; one applied when you choose a deck for a game applies to that game only, leaving the deck and every other copy of it untouched.

adminStats.title: Game Stats
adminStats.buildPrompt: These numbers are extracted from every saved game in one pass, which is too slow to do per page load. Press Rebuild to build them for the first time.
adminStats.mixFootnote: Mix bars are ordered light to dark: 1 to 4+ players, Easy to Expert. Hover a segment for its count. Games with more than four players are counted in the 4+ bucket.
adminStats.progressSub: Runs that have completed at least this many scenarios. The fall from one row to the next is where people stop.
adminStats.noProgress: No run of this campaign has finished a scenario yet.
adminStats.sideStoriesSub: Side stories played during a run of this campaign, and the share of runs that took each.
adminStats.noSideStories: No side story has been played in this campaign.
adminStats.hardestSub: Share of campaign attempts that ended in a resolution rather than a resignation or a wipe. Lowest first; scenarios with fewer than {n} attempts are left out.
adminStats.sideStoryHeading: Side stories played on their own
adminStats.noSideStoryPlays: No side story has been played standalone.
adminStats.standaloneSub: A standalone keeps no resolution record, so only whether it was seen through is known.
adminStats.achievementsSub: Share of the {n} people who have earned at least one achievement. Rarest first.
adminStats.noAchievements: Nobody has earned an achievement yet.
adminStats.outcomeUnknownSub: Finished before the engine recorded how a game ended. Press Work out outcomes to reconstruct them from what each campaign left behind.
adminStats.backfillUndecided: {undecided} could not be judged and were left alone.
adminStats.backfillDone: Every finished game has an outcome.
adminStats.endingsSub: Which ending each campaign’s runs actually stopped on, most common first. Only runs with a known outcome appear. “No resolution” is a final scenario lost or resigned out of.
adminStats.noEndings: No campaign has recorded an ending yet.
